claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.per_turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Defender's bonus-transfer ability is usable once per turn and resets automatically at turn start. No existing RestResetCadence variant models a per-turn refresh. The existing UsageLimit.once_per_turn gate handles the usage cap, but ActivatedAbilityMechanics requires a resource + resetCadence, and none of the rest-scoped reset cadences correctly describe a turn-scoped refill.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The first time you attack with the weapon on each of your turns, you can transfer some or all of the weapon's bonus to your Armor Class.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationValue.unit — 'until_caster_turn_start'
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The transferred bonus lasts until the start of the wielder's next turn. DurationValue.unit only admits 'round', 'minute', 'hour', 'day'. A 'round' approximation is close but semantically distinct: 'until your next turn starts' ends at initiative-count of the wielder, whereas '1 round' ends one full round later. Several SRD items and features use this exact phrasing, so the variant has broad applicability.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn, although you must hold the weapon to gain a bonus to AC from it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost — 'on_first_weapon_attack' trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The transfer choice happens 'the first time you attack with the weapon on each of your turns.' This is neither a free action (it is tied to making an attack), nor a replace_attack (the attack still happens normally). The existing reaction trigger grammar does not cover this weapon-attack-scoped window. The closest approximation — free cost + UsageLimit.once_per_turn — loses the weapon-attack gating entirely.
